newsitem.title: USA: Wall St opens slightly firmer after Friday dive.
newsitem.headline: Wall St opens slightly firmer after Friday dive.

text.p: Wall Street blue chips opened slightly higher on Monday after the Dow Jones Industrial Average tumbled three percent on Friday.
After 10 minutes of trade the Dow was up 9.99 points at 7,704.65.
It closed down 247 at 7,695 on Friday after the dollar slid and fears rose over future blue chip earnings.
It was unclear if below-expectation earnings announced by Hewlett-Packard on Monday would have much general market fallout, traders added.
